Gilan Gork - Debunking Psychics

By: Carol Albertyn Christie | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
Gilan Gork II – Debunking Psychics

South African mentalist Gilan Gork has approached us to do a programme that looks at debunking psychics. How psychics use psychological tools of influence and persuasion but having a psychic ability is a myth.

Our programme starts with the set up that Carte Blanche recruits a few volunteers who want to participate in a psychic experiment with Gilan.

The experiment is loosely based on a famous psychology experiment called the Barnum or Forer effect.

Here is an excerpt from Wiki that explains it.

The Forer effect (also called the Barnum effect after P. T. Barnum's observation that "we've got something for everyone") is the observation that individuals will give high accuracy ratings to descriptions of their personality that supposedly are tailored specifically for them, but are in fact vague and general enough to apply to a wide range of people. This effect can provide a partial explanation for the widespread acceptance of some beliefs and practices, such as astrology, fortune telling, graphology, religion, aura reading and some types of personality tests.

Further information:
In 1948, psychologist Bertram R. Forer gave a psychology test—his Diagnostic Interest Blank—to a group of his psychology students who were told that they would each receive a brief personality vignette or sketch based on their test results. One week later Forer gave each student a purportedly individualized sketch and asked each of them to rate it on how well it applied. In reality, each student received the same sketch, consisting of the following items:

1 You have a great need for other people to like and admire you.
2 You have a tendency to be critical of yourself.
3 You have a great deal of unused capacity which you have not turned to your advantage.

On average, the students rated its accuracy as 4.26 on a scale of 0 (very poor) to 5 (excellent). Only after the ratings were turned in was it revealed that each student had received an identical sketch assembled by Forer from a newsstand astrology book. The sketch contains statements that are vague and general enough to most people.

We will set up that Gilan will use a variety of psychic tools on our volunteers, he will perform individual readings using astrology, graphology, palmistry, tarot reading and pure psychic readings.
(Gilan and I , will work on how to accomplish this logistically).
Gilan has no training or belief in the the psychic tools mentioned above.

As in the Barnum, Gilan will create his own list of generic responses and he believes that the volunteers will give him a score of at least 80% for his accuracy.

We will interview the volunteers before hand and ask them about their expectations, we will then interview them after the reading about their feedback and his accuracy. We will then let them know that all of the volunteers received exactly the same generic response and get their reaction to this.

Gilan Gork does not believe that there are psychic powers, he believes that all psychics no matter what their discipline is use psychological tools to get information from their clients.

Gilan will take us through the various techniques that psychics use.

We will go undercover to a couple of psychics and film the readings and then get Gilan to look at the readings in an edit suite and identify the tools that were used.

To make it work I think we should send one of our researchers in to two or three psychics with the same story. In other words we could create a scenario that she would like some advice in her love life. She has just met a new man and would like to know whether this will be the man of her dreams.

Not only will we be able to look at the different advice that she receives from the psychics but we will also be able to see the psychological tools that they have used in her consultations.

(From a legal point of view I am sure that we will not be able to identify the psychic and may have to blur the face of the psychic and change their voice.)

Once we have the undercover work we will film Gilan looking at the footage at an edit suite and explain to us what techniques were used to get info from the sitter.

Here is Gilan’s document of some of issues that we will cover.

Carte Blanche – Influence and Persuasion: The Psychic Myth 25/02/2015

The Set Up
Before the reading itself begins, the cold reader can take some preliminary steps to get the reading off to a good start. The basic aim is to encourage a relaxed and co-operative atmosphere, in which the client will neither challenge nor impede the cold reading process. What follows is a list of some of the more common techniques for achieving this aim. Some psychics may use all of them, while others may only use one or two.
• Meeting and greeting
Some psychics specialise in 'mail order' or remote readings, but the majority are in the business of meeting and greeting people.

• Encouraging co-operative interpretation
The psychic takes care to mention that the tarot is not an exact science - it involves some elements of interpretation. She might use other terms, such as 'intuitive understanding' or 'sensitivity'. The point is to foster the notion that both she and the client are supposed to work together and co-operate. For example, the psychic might say something like: "I won't necessarily always know exactly what the cards are trying to say. Sometimes, it's not very clear, like looking through a mist, and the exact meaning will actually be clearer to you than it is to me! So do bear that in mind, won't you?"

• Establishing an intimate atmosphere
The psychic tries to establish a fairly intimate atmosphere for reading. The specifics are largely a matter of personal style. The psychic might use a slightly softer voice than normal, or adopt a very sympathetic and non-confrontational stance to foster rapport. Anything which conveys a sense of welcoming calm is good.

• Establishing psychic credentials
The psychic establishes her own credentials, and conveys the idea - explicitly or tacitly - that she is well-accredited, experienced and confident.

• Establishing the belief system
As well as establishing her own credentials, as above, the psychic also establishes the credentials of the tarot, or whatever divinatory system is on offer. This leads the client to take the proceedings seriously, if not necessarily solemnly. For example, the psychic may refer to the tarot's long history, or to how well accredited it is, or to the many clients who have benefited from its insights.

• Supplying a pre-emptive excuse for failure
In her introductory remarks, the psychic usually offers an up-front excuse for any outright failures which may arise later. She also makes it clear that she does not claim to get everything right all the time. For example, she might say something like: "I'll be honest enough to admit to you now that I do sometimes make mistakes. It would be wonderful to be absolutely spot on all the time, but after all, I'm only human, and I can only do my best for you. Do you understand?"

The Principal Themes
Psychic readings consist of themes. Themes provide the underlying shape and structure for a reading, and ensure that it is relevant to the subject's life. Cold readers rely on four chief themes:

• Love, romance and relationships
• Money and material comforts
• Career and progression
• Health and well-being

There are also three minor themes. These are generally not as important as the main four, but they can prove very fruitful. They are:

• Travel
• Education and the pursuit of new knowledge
• Ambitions, hopes and dreams

The Elements of the Reading

Cold reading does not involve a rehearsed script. It consists of numerous different types of statements and questions) which can appear more significant or meaningful than they really are. Each type of statement is called an 'element'. The cumulative effect of these elements is to create the illusion that a reading of a psychic or mystical nature is taking place.

Elements can belong to four groups (although there might be some overlap between them):

- about character
- about facts and events
- about extracting information
- about predicting the future

The Win-Win Game
How the psychic can turn a 'miss' into a 'hit', and otherwise recover from errors.
It should be clear that the ‘elements’ can deliver wonderful hits, and are likely to do so in many cases. However, this can never be guaranteed in all cases. There are going to be times when the psychic offers a particular statement which the client firmly rejects. If this happens, the psychic uses one of the ‘win-win’ methods to get out of trouble, fix the damage, and carry on as if nothing had happened. In other words, if the statement is a hit, the psychic wins, and if it is a miss, the psychic wins anyway!

Presentational Points
Aspects of presentation which can enhance the reading's effectiveness. There is more to cold reading than getting the actual content right. Purely presentational factors can also greatly assist the success of a reading.

Putting It All Together
An experienced builder has a good set of tools, which enable him to cope with most situations. The more tools and equipment he has, the greater the range of jobs he can handle. There may be some tools that he trusts and relies on more than others, and his preferences will reflect his own individual style of working.

Likewise with the psychic. The techniques and elements we have looked at so far are the tools of her trade - a sort of 'Psychic Toolbox' - which can be used to construct readings. It makes no sense to use every tool for every reading. All the psychic has to do is use the right tools to 'build' the right reading for each client. The more tools the psychic has at her disposal, the more versatile she is, and the more clients she can impress and satisfy.

Given that readings vary according to personal style, and are generally improvised rather than scripted, there is no one way to 'put it all together' and fashion a psychic reading. However, the majority of normal one-on-one readings can be said to proceed through the same five main phases:

- Set Up & Disarm
- Launch
- Bridge
- Expand
- Tidy Conclusion

Coping With Sceptics

How the psychic copes with highly skeptical or 'difficult' clients.
It is rare for a psychic to meet a client who is well-informed and sceptical. Most clients are either believers or non-committal. Many subscribe to the argument about 'keeping an open mind'. Others may claim to be sceptical, but know nothing about cold reading.The truly informed sceptic tends to stay away. However, even if a highly sceptical client does turn up, the cold reading process can cope through various lines of defence used by psychics.

Press Release:


Psychics have throughout history been both revered and reviled, their powers believed and disputed. People still rely on the predictions of trusted psychics and Tarot card readers to clarify life-events and help them make big decisions. But do they really have psychic abilities? Mentalist Gilan Gork shows Carte Blanche how little-known cold-reading techniques could in fact be behind apparent psychic insight.

Script:


Gilan Gork Script

V/O
Psychics have throughout history been both revered and reviled, their powers believed and disputed. Ceasar was warned by a seer about the Ides of March and Nostradamus’s predictions have confounded the public for centuries. The ability to see what is not seen is something still highly prized.

Gerald
“I pick up twins, there is twins in the family.”

Ursula
“Here’s marriage, here’s a baby, I see two children coming up from you in the cards.”

V/O
Just how accurate are psychics ? Mentalist Gilan Gork thinks that may not all they claim to be.

Gilan
“Do psychics have psychic powers?”

Bongani
“Do they have power, yes?”

Gilan
“I’ve never met anyone that I have not been able to replicate what they have done using non psychic methods.”

V/O
He’s not being arrogant, we met Gilan in 2012 when he miraculously drove Derek around a race course completely blindfolded.

“Wow this should be interesting.”

V/O
All he asked Derek to do was to concentrate on the road ahead.

Derek
“I must still look straight ahead?”









V/O
As a child, Gilan first learnt his craft as a magician, but mentalism, the power of influence and persuasion of the mind soon captured his attention.

“You sure you haven’t cut a little hole in here?”

Up Sound
“Miraculously Gilan managed to complete the course without seeing a thing.”
“And we have survived. What more can we ask for”.


Bongani
“Gilan Gork appears to be able to do the impossible anything from bending metal objects to powering light bulbs, all with the sheer power of thought. Is it magic or just a really good trick?”

Gilan
“Mentalism is quite a broad term actually and it usually has to do with the mind and reading what someone is thinking, like mind reading or thought transferral. It will be predicting what people will do or say in advance or influencing people.”

Up Sound
Gilan
“Are you looking at the colour blue?”
“Yes”
“You are looking at blue, excellent.”

V/O
Many of his tricks defy explanation, and it’s hard not to imagine that other forces are not at play.

Bongani
“Do you have psychic power?”
Gilan
“I do not have psychic power.”

V/O
Gilan uses subtle psychological techniques to influence people he does mentalism tricks on. Not unsimilar he says, to what psychics use.

Bongani
“Because you think psychics do that, they influence people?”

Gilan
“I think that they have an extraordinary ability to be able to communicate with people and to be able to activate certain triggers in someone’s mind which makes the person believe that what they are providing is real psychic insight, whereas it’s not that at all.”

V/O
According to Gilan many psychics use a technique called cold reading. This is an ability to glean information from a person’s appearance and their body language. Gilan says, that the psychics will also use high probability guesses and pick up signals whether these guesses are in the right direction or not. Carte Blanche went to a clairvoyant and a tarot reader to test their accuracy.

V/O
Gerald Burger is a well respected clairvoyant in Gauteng and has been giving readings for the past 40 years.


Gerald
“I just want you to touch the ball for me and just pick up your energy. Thanks.”

V/O
Dani Greenberg is 23 years old and is studying to become a teacher. She has volunteered to go and have her fortune told.

Gerald
“You teach people at the end of the day and that is very, very good.”

Dani
“I am actually studying to be a teacher.”

V/O
Ursula Wania has been reading tarot cards for 24 years.

Ursula
“I am seeing someone in the cards here that is causing a lot of trouble, is there anybody at the moment that there could be some problems around.”

Dani
“Ja”

Ursula
“OK, But I see an ending of that situation”

V/O
Gilan had a look at Dani’s two readings and showed us some of the ways that in his opinion the clairvoyant and tarot reader use cold reading techniques.

Gerald
“You are actually a very, very free spirit, you can party at 5 o’clock in the morning and 6 o’clock you are back at work.”

Dani
“Ja, OK”

Gilan
“Ok, so usually what will happen in a psychic reading is that they will start with character statements. Things that would apply to anyone but of course a skilled cold reader will also look at a person and take an educated guess on what would be right. Now Dani is a very young girl, she looks like she is someone who still has a lot of energy, so he’s throwing it out there, there is a good chance that he would be correct .


Gerald
“If I go to your past life, you was in the medical line.”

Dani
“And not a princess?”

Gilan
“Now no-one can prove or disprove this. But what is really clever about what he is doing is that by saying in your past life, if it is something that does not relate to her at all and she does not connect with anything medical, then that will be forgotten and we will move on. But if she says I am studying medicine now or he would then be able to delve into it and use it as a confirmation.”

V/O
Part of our brain’s programming is to compulsively find patterns and meaning in information, in other words to join the dots. Gilan says that psychics use this trait in their readings.


Gilan
“What they are really trying to get your to do is to find an answer in your mind and the fact that you start searching for an answer for that means that you are , without knowing it using your pattern making machine , which is your brain to take what they have said, which is really suggestive and you then apply it and give the feedback.”

Dani
“When anyone in my family has a cut or a sore or they are dying I’m the person to go to. I love cleaning it, putting plasters. I find that stuff quite interesting.”

Bongani
“When a psychic gets a random piece of information correct is it just luck?”

Gilan
“Sometime’s its luck, in any psychic reading there will be at least one or two times when they will throw something out there and if it’s a hit - that’s great and if it’s a miss well they will move along and either forget it and make it seem minor or they will somehow try and change it to become some sort of a near hit.”

Ursula
“And this G do you know anyone who is G ,its coming up quite strong, as well as B or R?”

Gilan
“ Ok she just said this G who is this G is coming up quite strong and then also a B and an R , there should at least be 1 hit.

Dani
“B is my best friend Bianca and R is my Dad’s name”

Gilan
“If I was sitting in front of someone , my rational mind would think is it the G or the B?”

Ursula
“Have you got a boyfriend at the moment?
“You do work Ok?
“Do you want to study or do you study?”
Ok
“When do you finish studying?”
Cause I see changes in your studies”


Bongani
“How do you think she is doing so far?”

Glan
“So far I must admit that she is asking probably 5 or 6 times as many questions as statements she is saying. and if I was going to a psychic reader and they asked me this many questions, I would wonder where she is getting her information from. The cards or from me?”

Bongani
Gilan Gork the mentalist says you use cold reading techniques?

Ursula
You know what, first of all I am not psychic , I don’t advertise I am psychic. I don’t tell anyone I am psychic. I do tarot card readings. Everything I that I am telling the client or picking up, I am actually picking up through the tarot, through the cards, I don’t assume anything or make assumptions or ask them a question and hope they are going to tell me. If I don’t see it in the cards I don’t ask it.

Dani
“She was very accurate with my family, she got the family affairs like quite accurate, that for me was quite impressive.”

V/O
Although Ursula says she is not a psychic, she still offers a service in which she advises people about events that are in the future.

Bongani
“Why do you ask so many questions in your readings?”

Ursula
“Ok for egsample with initials, lets say I see an initial come up, most of the time it will relate to a situation and if they can tell me who the person is then I can tell them more about what I see.”

V/O
Many people seek out clairvoyants for the comfort of contacting loved ones who have passed over.

Gerald
“What I pick up there in the spiritual world is that somebody you know that committed suicide?

Dani
“Hectic. My aunt.”

Gilan
“We all know someone who committed suicide and so he is just throwing that out there. What we call a fuzzy fact , he is just throwing it out there , she responds immediately saying my aunt and now he knows he has a hit.”

Gerald
“Ja, she commit suicide and she said sorry that I did it.

Gilan
“She says “yes, my Aunt”, he says “Ja”. She committed suicide. Well he is just repeating what she told him and he is saying it like a comfirmation as if it’s a piece of psychic insight he’s received. Whereas he has received it from Dani.”

V/O
We gave Gerald the opportunity to give his right of reply to Gilan’s comments about his reading but he declined the offer.

Dani
“If he has said death, a lot of people die, but he specified that it definitely was a suicide. That for me is something that isn’t generalised.”

Bongani
“Would you go again to a psychic?”

Dani
“Yes definitely. There is the generalised but there is the moments where you will be like “Oh my goodness” , how does the person know that?”

Bongani
To test the power of persuasion we have set up an experiment for 3 people who think they are coming in for a psychic reading. What they don’t know is that Gilan will give them the same reading almost word for word.

V/O
This experiment demonstrates that how people will apply blanket statements to their lives.

“Something that is quite strong over here I can tell is that you are not someone to harbour and hold grudges. Although I do sense that if someone does treat you badly they will be on the receiving end of quite an icy blast.

Adam
“If I react I over react.”

Gilan
“ I do feel sorry for anyone who hurts anyone you are close to. Any one you care for. You are a carer?”

Kyla
“ Ya, ya”

Gilan
“You are good at not holding grudges but you never forget an enemy. Someone who you perceive to hurt someone you care for.”

Sanam
“Yes”

Gilan
“That’s great”

Kyla
“Nobody must hurt the people that I love.”

Bongani
“On an accuracy scale from 1 – 10 how would you rate him?”

Kyla
“I want to say a 9 or a 10, but I also feel a lot of the statements are blanket statements.”

Adam
“I’d probably go between 6 and 7. He was quite accurate.”

Bongani
“Did you feel it was genuine and this was the real deal?”

Sanam
“Part of me feels that this could just be inferred from behaviour and micro expressions, but part of me also thought that maybe there is truth to it.”

V/O
We told them all they had received exactly the same reading.

Kyla “ I would laugh.”


Adam
“I did want to believe it is good it is positive.”

Bongani

Perhaps people will never stop believing in psychics what was interesting for me is that all 3 of our subjects said that despite their scepticism they wanted to believe what they were being told and perhaps that is the real power that psychics have.”

Promo 1 - 15 sec

Throughout history psychics have been both revered and reviled. Is it all trickery ? Well known South African mentalist Gilan Gork thinks so.
“I’ve never met anyone who I have not been able to replicate what they have done using non psychic methods.”

Promo 2 - 15 sec

“Well, I pick up twins, there’s twins in the family.”
“There’s marriage, there is a baby, I see two children coming up for you in your cards.”

V/O
Can psychics really see the future? Gilan Gork believes that they use the same psychological techniques he uses in mentalism.


Promo 3 - 10 secs

How accurate are psychics? Well known, mentalist Gilan Gork suggests that they are masters of influence and persuasion.
“A lot of people believe because they want to believe.”

Cold readers rely on four chief themes: • Love, romance and relationships • Money and material comforts • Career and progression • Health and well-being There are also three minor themes. These are generally not as important as the main four, but they can prove very fruitful. They are: • Travel • Education and the pursuit of new knowledge • Ambitions, hopes and dreams The Elements of the Reading Cold reading does not involve a rehearsed script. It consists of numerous different types of statements and questions) which can appear more significant or meaningful than they really are. Each type of statement is called an 'element'. The cumulative effect of these elements is to create the illusion that a reading of a psychic or mystical nature is taking place. Elements can belong to four groups (although there might be some overlap between them): - about character - about facts and events - about extracting information - about predicting the future The Win-Win Game How the psychic can turn a 'miss' into a 'hit', and otherwise recover from errors. It should be clear that the ‘elements’ can deliver wonderful hits, and are likely to do so in many cases. However, this can never be guaranteed in all cases. There are going to be times when the psychic offers a particular statement which the client firmly rejects. If this happens, the psychic uses one of the ‘win-win’ methods to get out of trouble, fix the damage, and carry on as if nothing had happened. In other words, if the statement is a hit, the psychic wins, and if it is a miss, the psychic wins anyway! Presentational Points Aspects of presentation which can enhance the reading's effectiveness. There is more to cold reading than getting the actual content right. Purely presentational factors can also greatly assist the success of a reading. Putting It All Together An experienced builder has a good set of tools, which enable him to cope with most situations. The more tools and equipment he has, the greater the range of jobs he can handle. There may be some tools that he trusts and relies on more than others, and his preferences will reflect his own individual style of working. Likewise with the psychic. The techniques and elements we have looked at so far are the tools of her trade - a sort of 'Psychic Toolbox' - which can be used to construct readings. It makes no sense to use every tool for every reading. All the psychic has to do is use the right tools to 'build' the right reading for each client. The more tools the psychic has at her disposal, the more versatile she is, and the more clients she can impress and satisfy. Given that readings vary according to personal style, and are generally improvised rather than scripted, there is no one way to 'put it all together' and fashion a psychic reading. However, the majority of normal one-on-one readings can be said to proceed through the same five main phases: - Set Up & Disarm - Launch - Bridge - Expand - Tidy Conclusion Coping With Sceptics How the psychic copes with highly skeptical or 'difficult' clients. It is rare for a psychic to meet a client who is well-informed and sceptical. Most clients are either believers or non-committal. Many subscribe to the argument about 'keeping an open mind'. Others may claim to be sceptical, but know nothing about cold reading.The truly informed sceptic tends to stay away. However, even if a highly sceptical client does turn up, the cold reading process can cope through various lines of defence used by psychics. People still rely on the predictions of trusted psychics and Tarot card readers to clarify life-events and help them make big decisions. But do they really have psychic abilities? Mentalist Gilan Gork shows Carte Blanche how little-known cold-reading techniques could in fact be behind apparent psychic insight. Script: Gilan Gork Script V/O Psychics have throughout history been both revered and reviled, their powers believed and disputed. Ceasar was warned by a seer about the Ides of March and Nostradamus’s predictions have confounded the public for centuries. The ability to see what is not seen is something still highly prized. Gerald “I pick up twins, there is twins in the family.” Ursula “Here’s marriage, here’s a baby, I see two children coming up from you in the cards.” V/O Just how accurate are psychics ? Mentalist Gilan Gork thinks that may not all they claim to be. Gilan “Do psychics have psychic powers?” Bongani “Do they have power, yes?” Gilan “I’ve never met anyone that I have not been able to replicate what they have done using non psychic methods.” V/O He’s not being arrogant, we met Gilan in 2012 when he miraculously drove Derek around a race course completely blindfolded. “Wow this should be interesting.” V/O All he asked Derek to do was to concentrate on the road ahead. Derek “I must still look straight ahead?” V/O As a child, Gilan first learnt his craft as a magician, but mentalism, the power of influence and persuasion of the mind soon captured his attention. “You sure you haven’t cut a little hole in here?” Up Sound “Miraculously Gilan managed to complete the course without seeing a thing.” “And we have survived. What more can we ask for”. Bongani “Gilan Gork appears to be able to do the impossible anything from bending metal objects to powering light bulbs, all with the sheer power of thought. Is it magic or just a really good trick?” Gilan “Mentalism is quite a broad term actually and it usually has to do with the mind and reading what someone is thinking, like mind reading or thought transferral. It will be predicting what people will do or say in advance or influencing people.” Up Sound Gilan “Are you looking at the colour blue?” “Yes” “You are looking at blue, excellent.” V/O Many of his tricks defy explanation, and it’s hard not to imagine that other forces are not at play. Bongani “Do you have psychic power?” Gilan “I do not have psychic power.” V/O Gilan uses subtle psychological techniques to influence people he does mentalism tricks on. Not unsimilar he says, to what psychics use. Bongani “Because you think psychics do that, they influence people?” Gilan “I think that they have an extraordinary ability to be able to communicate with people and to be able to activate certain triggers in someone’s mind which makes the person believe that what they are providing is real psychic insight, whereas it’s not that at all.” V/O According to Gilan many psychics use a technique called cold reading. This is an ability to glean information from a person’s appearance and their body language. Gilan says, that the psychics will also use high probability guesses and pick up signals whether these guesses are in the right direction or not. Carte Blanche went to a clairvoyant and a tarot reader to test their accuracy. V/O Gerald Burger is a well respected clairvoyant in Gauteng and has been giving readings for the past 40 years. Gerald “I just want you to touch the ball for me and just pick up your energy. Thanks.” V/O Dani Greenberg is 23 years old and is studying to become a teacher. She has volunteered to go and have her fortune told. Gerald “You teach people at the end of the day and that is very, very good.” Dani “I am actually studying to be a teacher.” V/O Ursula Wania has been reading tarot cards for 24 years. Ursula “I am seeing someone in the cards here that is causing a lot of trouble, is there anybody at the moment that there could be some problems around.” Dani “Ja” Ursula “OK, But I see an ending of that situation” V/O Gilan had a look at Dani’s two readings and showed us some of the ways that in his opinion the clairvoyant and tarot reader use cold reading techniques. Gerald “You are actually a very, very free spirit, you can party at 5 o’clock in the morning and 6 o’clock you are back at work.” Dani “Ja, OK” Gilan “Ok, so usually what will happen in a psychic reading is that they will start with character statements. Things that would apply to anyone but of course a skilled cold reader will also look at a person and take an educated guess on what would be right. Now Dani is a very young girl, she looks like she is someone who still has a lot of energy, so he’s throwing it out there, there is a good chance that he would be correct . Gerald “If I go to your past life, you was in the medical line.” Dani “And not a princess?” Gilan “Now no-one can prove or disprove this. But what is really clever about what he is doing is that by saying in your past life, if it is something that does not relate to her at all and she does not connect with anything medical, then that will be forgotten and we will move on. But if she says I am studying medicine now or he would then be able to delve into it and use it as a confirmation.” V/O Part of our brain’s programming is to compulsively find patterns and meaning in information, in other words to join the dots. Gilan says that psychics use this trait in their readings. Gilan “What they are really trying to get your to do is to find an answer in your mind and the fact that you start searching for an answer for that means that you are , without knowing it using your pattern making machine , which is your brain to take what they have said, which is really suggestive and you then apply it and give the feedback.” Dani “When anyone in my family has a cut or a sore or they are dying I’m the person to go to. I love cleaning it, putting plasters. I find that stuff quite interesting.” Bongani “When a psychic gets a random piece of information correct is it just luck?” Gilan “Sometime’s its luck, in any psychic reading there will be at least one or two times when they will throw something out there and if it’s a hit - that’s great and if it’s a miss well they will move along and either forget it and make it seem minor or they will somehow try and change it to become some sort of a near hit.” Ursula “And this G do you know anyone who is G ,its coming up quite strong, as well as B or R?” Gilan “ Ok she just said this G who is this G is coming up quite strong and then also a B and an R , there should at least be 1 hit. Dani “B is my best friend Bianca and R is my Dad’s name” Gilan “If I was sitting in front of someone , my rational mind would think is it the G or the B?” Ursula “Have you got a boyfriend at the moment? “You do work Ok? “Do you want to study or do you study?” Ok “When do you finish studying?” Cause I see changes in your studies” Bongani “How do you think she is doing so far?” Glan “So far I must admit that she is asking probably 5 or 6 times as many questions as statements she is saying. and if I was going to a psychic reader and they asked me this many questions, I would wonder where she is getting her information from. The cards or from me?” Bongani Gilan Gork the mentalist says you use cold reading techniques? Ursula You know what, first of all I am not psychic , I don’t advertise I am psychic. I don’t tell anyone I am psychic. I do tarot card readings. Everything I that I am telling the client or picking up, I am actually picking up through the tarot, through the cards, I don’t assume anything or make assumptions or ask them a question and hope they are going to tell me. If I don’t see it in the cards I don’t ask it. Dani “She was very accurate with my family, she got the family affairs like quite accurate, that for me was quite impressive.” V/O Although Ursula says she is not a psychic, she still offers a service in which she advises people about events that are in the future. Bongani “Why do you ask so many questions in your readings?” Ursula “Ok for egsample with initials, lets say I see an initial come up, most of the time it will relate to a situation and if they can tell me who the person is then I can tell them more about what I see.” V/O Many people seek out clairvoyants for the comfort of contacting loved ones who have passed over. Gerald “What I pick up there in the spiritual world is that somebody you know that committed suicide? Dani “Hectic. My aunt.” Gilan “We all know someone who committed suicide and so he is just throwing that out there. What we call a fuzzy fact , he is just throwing it out there , she responds immediately saying my aunt and now he knows he has a hit.” Gerald “Ja, she commit suicide and she said sorry that I did it. Gilan “She says “yes, my Aunt”, he says “Ja”. She committed suicide. Well he is just repeating what she told him and he is saying it like a comfirmation as if it’s a piece of psychic insight he’s received. Whereas he has received it from Dani.” V/O We gave Gerald the opportunity to give his right of reply to Gilan’s comments about his reading but he declined the offer. Dani “If he has said death, a lot of people die, but he specified that it definitely was a suicide. That for me is something that isn’t generalised.” Bongani “Would you go again to a psychic?” Dani “Yes definitely. There is the generalised but there is the moments where you will be like “Oh my goodness” , how does the person know that?” Bongani To test the power of persuasion we have set up an experiment for 3 people who think they are coming in for a psychic reading. What they don’t know is that Gilan will give them the same reading almost word for word. V/O This experiment demonstrates that how people will apply blanket statements to their lives. “Something that is quite strong over here I can tell is that you are not someone to harbour and hold grudges. Although I do sense that if someone does treat you badly they will be on the receiving end of quite an icy blast. Adam “If I react I over react.” Gilan “ I do feel sorry for anyone who hurts anyone you are close to. Any one you care for. You are a carer?” Kyla “ Ya, ya” Gilan “You are good at not holding grudges but you never forget an enemy. Someone who you perceive to hurt someone you care for.” Sanam “Yes” Gilan “That’s great” Kyla “Nobody must hurt the people that I love.” Bongani “On an accuracy scale from 1 – 10 how would you rate him?” Kyla “I want to say a 9 or a 10, but I also feel a lot of the statements are blanket statements.” Adam “I’d probably go between 6 and 7. He was quite accurate.” Bongani “Did you feel it was genuine and this was the real deal?” Sanam “Part of me feels that this could just be inferred from behaviour and micro expressions, but part of me also thought that maybe there is truth to it.” V/O We told them all they had received exactly the same reading. Kyla “ I would laugh.” Adam “I did want to believe it is good it is positive.” Bongani Perhaps people will never stop believing in psychics what was interesting for me is that all 3 of our subjects said that despite their scepticism they wanted to believe what they were being told and perhaps that is the real power that psychics have.” Promo 1 - 15 sec Throughout history psychics have been both revered and reviled. Well known, mentalist Gilan Gork suggests that they are masters of influence and persuasion. “A lot of people believe because they want to believe.”

metadata.Summary: Gilan Gork II – Debunking Psychics South African mentalist Gilan Gork has approached us to do a programme that looks at debunking psychics. How psychics use psychological tools of influence and persuasion but having a psychic ability is a myth. Our programme starts with the set up that Carte Blanche recruits a few volunteers who want to participate in a psychic experiment with Gilan. The experiment is loosely based on a famous psychology experiment called the Barnum or Forer effect. Here is an excerpt from Wiki that explains it. The Forer effect (also called the Barnum effect after P. T. Barnum's observation that "we've got something for everyone") is the observation that individuals will give high accuracy ratings to descriptions of their personality that supposedly are tailored specifically for them, but are in fact vague and general enough to apply to a wide range of people. This effect can provide a partial explanation for the widespread acceptance of some beliefs and practices, such as astrology, fortune telling, graphology, religion, aura reading and some types of personality tests.
metadata.Further information: In 1948, psychologist Bertram R. Forer gave a psychology test—his Diagnostic Interest Blank—to a group of his psychology students who were told that they would each receive a brief personality vignette or sketch based on their test results. One week later Forer gave each student a purportedly individualized sketch and asked each of them to rate it on how well it applied. In reality, each student received the same sketch, consisting of the following items: 1 You have a great need for other people to like and admire you. 2 You have a tendency to be critical of yourself. 3 You have a great deal of unused capacity which you have not turned to your advantage. On average, the students rated its accuracy as 4.26 on a scale of 0 (very poor) to 5 (excellent). Only after the ratings were turned in was it revealed that each student had received an identical sketch assembled by Forer from a newsstand astrology book. The sketch contains statements that are vague and general enough to most people. We will set up that Gilan will use a variety of psychic tools on our volunteers, he will perform individual readings using astrology, graphology, palmistry, tarot reading and pure psychic readings. (Gilan and I , will work on how to accomplish this logistically). Gilan has no training or belief in the the psychic tools mentioned above. As in the Barnum, Gilan will create his own list of generic responses and he believes that the volunteers will give him a score of at least 80% for his accuracy. We will interview the volunteers before hand and ask them about their expectations, we will then interview them after the reading about their feedback and his accuracy. We will then let them know that all of the volunteers received exactly the same generic response and get their reaction to this. Gilan Gork does not believe that there are psychic powers, he believes that all psychics no matter what their discipline is use psychological tools to get information from their clients. Gilan will take us through the various techniques that psychics use. We will go undercover to a couple of psychics and film the readings and then get Gilan to look at the readings in an edit suite and identify the tools that were used. To make it work I think we should send one of our researchers in to two or three psychics with the same story. In other words we could create a scenario that she would like some advice in her love life. She has just met a new man and would like to know whether this will be the man of her dreams. Not only will we be able to look at the different advice that she receives from the psychics but we will also be able to see the psychological tools that they have used in her consultations. (From a legal point of view I am sure that we will not be able to identify the psychic and may have to blur the face of the psychic and change their voice.) Once we have the undercover work we will film Gilan looking at the footage at an edit suite and explain to us what techniques were used to get info from the sitter. She might use other terms, such as 'intuitive understanding' or 'sensitivity'. The point is to foster the notion that both she and the client are supposed to work together and co-operate. For example, the psychic might say something like: "I won't necessarily always know exactly what the cards are trying to say. Sometimes, it's not very clear, like looking through a mist, and the exact meaning will actually be clearer to you than it is to me! So do bear that in mind, won't you?" • Establishing an intimate atmosphere The psychic tries to establish a fairly intimate atmosphere for reading. For example, she might say something like: "I'll be honest enough to admit to you now that I do sometimes make mistakes.
